|game_text=While Massasi Base Operations on table, opponent may deploy only one Imperial to each Yavin 4 site per turn. Doubles Rebel Tech bonus to Attack Run. Once per turn, may take Balanced Attack or a commander into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.

|notes=The 2006 slip puts Balanced Attack before the commander option and prints Massasi Base Operations. The [[Colonel Feyn Gospic (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[Colonel Feyn Gospic (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
